_implementation_notes: Tone: Lively, questioning, politically aware. Cerulean is where cracks in the system
first become visible. Misty is the reformer. Fusion debate is in the open here.
NOTE: Blue's dialogue (E9 on Map 1) is handled in cerulean_blue.json.
NOTE: Event 50 (Officer) has complex multi-page quest logic — only modifying dialogue
text, not restructuring the quest flow.
NOTE: Event 52 (Petrel quest) has complex quest logic — light touch on dialogue only.
Line length limit: ~42 characters per line for RPG Maker XP text box.
Added: Misty positional choice (Map 4, insert_commands, switches 1132-1133, var 342).
Added: Nugget Bridge recruiter choice (Map 8, insert_commands, switch 1134).
Added: New city NPCs (Map 1 events 1, 17, 23, 47, 50) and gym event 9.
